name: Tatewaki Rintarou
source:
3rd year student.
Star Sign: Aries
Likes: Yakisoba Bread
Dislikes: Nothing

Cheerful and popular in class because of his consideration for others.
His small size doesn't hold him back as he wields only a chainsaw to create huge sculptures. He has great respect for his grandfather who is a famous sculptor.
His hobby is cooking.
He's a cousin of [url=/c53458]Tsukushi Monet[/url] and often helps him out.
